# TentoUI - Complete AI & LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)

# TentoUI

> AntDesign-patterned Blazor UI Component Library styled with Tailwind CSS v4 for .NET 10.

## Overview
- Framework: .NET 10 Blazor (InteractiveServer, InteractiveWebAssembly, InteractiveAuto)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first engine with `@theme` bridge and design tokens (`--tento-*`)
- Component Catalog: 75+ components (General, Layout, Navigation, Data Entry, Data Display, Feedback)
- Full LLM Reference: `/llms-full.txt`
- Version Manifest: `/versions.json`

## Quick Start
```bash
dotnet add package TentoUI
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli
```

In `Program.cs`:
```csharp
builder.Services.AddTentoUI();
```

In `_Imports.razor`:
```razor
@using TentoUI
@using TentoUI.Configuration
```

In `Styles/app.tailwind.css`:
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "../tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.theme.css";
@source "../tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.classes.txt";
@source "../Components/**/*.razor";
@source "../Pages/**/*.razor";
```

In `<head>`:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="_content/TentoUI/tentoui.min.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/tailwind.min.css" />
<script src="_content/TentoUI/tentoui.js"></script>
```

In `MainLayout.razor`:
```razor
<ModalHost />
<NotificationHost />
<MessageHost />
```

## AI Agent Skills
Run in your project root:
```bash
dotnet msbuild -t:TentoUIInstallSkills
```
This unpacks `tentoui-components` and `tentoui-tailwind-setup` skills for AI agents.

## Core Component Types & References
- Buttons & Shortcuts: Button, CopyButton, FloatButton, FloatButtonGroup, BackTop, Kbd, HotkeyListener
- Typography: Title, Text (Copyable, Editable, Keyboard, Code), Paragraph, Link
- Layout: Flex, Splitter (SplitterPanel), Grid (Row, Col), Layout (Header, Sider, Content, Footer), Space, Divider
- Navigation: CommandPalette, ContextMenu, Menu, Dropdown, Tabs, Pagination, Steps, Breadcrumb, Anchor, Affix
- Data Entry: Input, InputNumber (NumberInput), TextArea, MarkdownEditor, Mentions, OTPInput (InputOTP), PromptInput, CronBuilder, SignaturePad, AvatarUpload, Select, AutoComplete, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker, TimeRangePicker, ColorPicker, Slider, Rate, Upload, Transfer, Cascader, TreeSelect, FilterBuilder, Form (FormItem)
- Data Display: Table, DataGridVirtual, KanbanBoard, Sparkline, Gauge, MeterGroup, CodeBlock, DiffViewer, ChatBubble, Card, List (ListView), Descriptions, Tree, Collapse, Carousel, Image, ImagePreviewGroup, Calendar, Badge, Avatar, Tag, Statistic, QRCode, Segmented, Watermark, Empty, Popover, Tooltip
- Feedback: Modal, Drawer, Alert, Message, Notification, Popconfirm, Progress, Result, Skeleton, Spin, Tour

# TentoUI Components Skill

Authoritative guide for building, styling, and wrapping TentoUI Blazor components based on Tailwind CSS and AntDesign patterns.

## Use this skill when

- Developing frontend UI in TentoTemplate Blazor applications (.NET 10).
- Building responsive pages, forms, data tables, dialogs, alerts, and navigation menus.
- Creating reusable UI wrappers or compound design system components on top of TentoUI.
- Implementing dark mode, custom color themes, and CSS custom property token cascade (`--tento-*`).
- Ensuring full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance (keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, focus trapping).
- Writing bUnit / xUnit automated component tests for UI interactions and state bindings.

## Do not use this skill when

- Writing backend CQRS domain entities, commands, queries, or database migrations (use `template-architecture-cqrs`).
- Configuring authentication, user identity tokens, or role authorization handlers (use `module-auth-users`).
- Implementing payment gateways such as Stripe or PayU (use `module-payments`).
- Generating PDF documents or QR code barcodes (use `module-documents-qr`).
- Modifying raw server infrastructure, Dockerfiles, or CI/CD pipelines.

## Core Architecture & Rules

1. **Framework Target**: .NET 10 (`net10.0`) with `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web` and `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms`.
2. **Tailwind CSS Utility Foundations**:
   - Zero inline hex colors (`style="color: #1677ff"` is strictly prohibited).
   - All styling MUST be achieved via semantic Tailwind CSS utility classes (`text-primary-600`, `bg-white dark:bg-slate-900`, `border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`).
   - Use `CssBuilder` and `StyleBuilder` for conditional class and style composition.
3. **Theme and Design Tokens**:
   - Central theme tokens are configured via `TentoTheme` and rendered by `TentoConfigProvider`.
   - The CSS token cascade emits 14 core custom properties:
     - `--tento-bg-app`, `--tento-bg-surface`, `--tento-bg-subtle`
     - `--tento-text-base`, `--tento-text-muted`, `--tento-text-inverse`
     - `--tento-border-base`
     - `--tento-primary-500`, `--tento-primary-600`
     - `--tento-success`, `--tento-warning`, `--tento-error`, `--tento-info`
     - `--tento-radius-md`, `--tento-font-family`
4. **Component Base Model**:
   - All visual components inherit from `TentoComponentBase` (providing `Class`, `Style`, `AdditionalAttributes`, `ConfigContext`, `ResolvedTheme`, `CurrentSize`, `ResolvedSize`).
   - All form controls inherit from `TentoInputBase<TValue>` (providing two-way `@bind-Value`, validation status cascade, change events, and disabled states).
5. **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Invariants**:
   - Focus indicators MUST use `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500`.
   - Form inputs MUST link to labels via `<label for="{id}">` or provide `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`.
   - Dialogs MUST have `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`, and `aria-describedby`.
   - Dynamic feedback components MUST use `aria-live="polite"` or `role="alert"`.
   - Interactive components MUST handle full keyboard interactions (`Enter`, `Space`, `Escape`, `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`).

## API & Component Catalog Reference

### 1. General & Layout
- `Button`: Primary, Default, Dashed, Text, Link variants; `Danger`, `Loading`, `Disabled`, `Size`, `Shape`, `IconName` (or child `<Icon Name="..." />`), `IconTemplate`, `HtmlType`.
- `CopyButton`: One-click clipboard copy button with `Text`, `CopyLabel`, `CopiedLabel`, `ShowLabel`, `Type`, `Size`, transient checkmark feedback, and `OnCopy` callback.
- `FloatButton`, `FloatButtonGroup`, `BackTop`: Corner floating action button (FAB) supporting shapes (`Circle`, `Square`), types (`Default`, `Primary`), tooltips, badges, stacked groups, and smooth window scroll-to-top.
- `Typography`: `Title` (Level 1-5), `Text` (Type: Secondary, Success, Warning, Danger, Disabled, Mark, Code, Keyboard, Italic, Strong, `Copyable`, `Editable`), `Paragraph` (`Ellipsis`, `Rows`, `Copyable`, `Editable`), `Link`.
- `Icon`: Embedded Lucide SVGs via `IconNames`, scalable `Size`, color inheritance, `Spin` rotation, accessible `AriaLabel`.
- `Kbd` & `HotkeyListener`: Tactile keyboard shortcut badges (`<Kbd Keys="Ctrl+Shift+P" />`) and focusable keyboard shortcut listeners (`<HotkeyListener Shortcut="Ctrl+K" OnTrigger="..." />`).
- `Divider`: Horizontal or Vertical, optional title text with `Orientation` (Left, Center, Right), dashed style.
- `Flex`: Declarative flexbox container supporting `Vertical`, `Wrap` (`NoWrap`, `Wrap`, `WrapReverse`), `Justify`, `Align`, `Gap` (`None`, `Small`, `Middle`, `Large`), and custom `GapSize`.
- `Splitter` & `SplitterPanel`: Resizable horizontal/vertical split panes with keyboard arrow adjustments, `Min`/`Max` bounds, and `Collapsible` toggle.
- `Layout`, `Header`, `Sider`, `Content`, `Footer`: Flexbox responsive layout with collapsible sidebar, trigger, and breakpoint listener.
- `Row` & `Col`: 24-column grid system with `Gutter` (horizontal/vertical tuple), `Justify`, `Align`, and responsive span breakpoints (`Xs`, `Sm`, `Md`, `Lg`, `Xl`, `Xxl`).
- `Space`: Direction (`Horizontal`, `Vertical`), `Size` (`Small`, `Middle`, `Large`, or custom px), `Align`, `Wrap`.

### 2. Navigation
- `CommandPalette`: Spotlight-style global command menu (`Ctrl+K`) with grouped `CommandItem` entries, keyboard navigation, shortcut badges, and `OnSelect` callback.
- `ContextMenu`: Right-click (`@oncontextmenu` and `Shift+F10`) floating context menu supporting `DropdownMenuItem` items or custom `Overlay`.
- `Menu`: Modes (`Horizontal`, `Vertical`, `Inline`), Themes (`Light`, `Dark`), `SelectedKey`, `OpenKeys`, collapsible sidebar integration.
- `MenuItem`, `SubMenu`, `MenuGroup`, `MenuDivider`: Hierarchical navigation items with icon slots and selection callbacks.
- `Breadcrumb` & `BreadcrumbItem`: Semantic navigation breadcrumbs with customizable separators and route links.
- `Tabs` & `TabPane`: Tab types (`Line`, `Card`), positions (`Top`, `Bottom`, `Left`, `Right`), dynamic tab items, closable tabs.
- `Pagination`: Standalone pagination bar with `PageIndex`, `PageSize`, `TotalItems`, `ShowSizeChanger`, `PageSizeOptions`, `ShowQuickJumper`, `Simple` mode, and smart ellipsis windowing.
- `Steps` & `Step`: Stepper indicator (`Horizontal`, `Vertical`), step statuses (`Wait`, `Process`, `Finish`, `Error`), custom icons, and clickable `OnChange` navigation.
- `Dropdown`: Menu dropdown with `Click` or `Hover` triggers, placements (`BottomLeft`, `BottomRight`, `TopLeft`, etc.), `DropdownMenuItem` list, or custom `Overlay` fragment.
- `Anchor` & `AnchorLink`: Scroll-spy table of contents navigation with active indicator line and smooth target scrolling.
- `Affix`: Sticky pinned viewport container supporting `OffsetTop` and `OffsetBottom`.

### 3. Data Entry
- `Form<TModel>`: Seamless integration with Blazor `EditContext`, `DataAnnotationsValidator`, layouts (`Vertical`, `Horizontal`, `Inline`), unified submission handling.
- `FormItem`: Label, required indicator (`*`), help text, extra description, automatic validation status error display.
- `Input`: Text, password, search, with prefix/suffix icons, clear button (`AllowClear`), size variants.
- `InputNumber<TValue>`: Numeric input with step increment/decrement controls, `Min`, `Max`, `Step`, and prefix slot.
- `AutoComplete`: Text input with real-time suggestion dropdown, custom filter predicates, and keyboard navigation.
- `TimePicker`: Hour, minute, and second selector with popup columns, `HourStep`, `MinuteStep`, `SecondStep`, and quick "Now" selection.
- `ColorPicker`: Color picker with swatch button trigger, preset color palette buttons, native OS color picker, and hex/rgb input.
- `Cascader`: Multi-level cascading dropdown selection for hierarchical categories and regional data.
- `TreeSelect`: Dropdown select with an integrated search-filtered tree view.
- `Transfer`: Dual-list shuttle selector for transferring items between Source and Target lists with item search and select all.
- `TextArea`: Multi-line text input with `Rows`, `AutoResize`, and character counter.
- `SearchInput`: Search button slot, `OnSearch` callback, enter-key trigger.
- `Select<TItem, TValue>`: Single and multiple selection, search filtering, option templates, clear button, keyboard navigation.
- `Checkbox` & `CheckboxGroup<TValue>`: Checkbox state, indeterminate support, group option arrays or template children.
- `Radio<TValue>` & `RadioGroup<TValue>`: Radio buttons and segmented button toggle groups (`RadioOptionType.Button`).
- `Switch`: High-contrast toggle switch with loading spinner and checked/unchecked labels.
- `Slider`: Range slider with `Min`, `Max`, `Step`, `Marks` dictionary, `ShowValue`, and `TipFormatter`.
- `Rate`: Star rating selector with `Count`, `AllowClear`, `Tooltips`, custom `Character`, and `ReadOnly`/`Disabled` states.
- `DatePicker`: Accessible date input with calendar picker popup, format strings, and keyboard shortcuts.
- `DateRangePicker`: Start and end date range selector with quick range presets (`Today`, `Last 7 Days`, `Last 30 Days`, `This Month`) and calendar range highlighting.
- `TimeRangePicker`: Dual-column start and end time range selector with configurable `MinuteStep` and quick business-hours shortcut.
- `Mentions`: Input or multi-line textarea with `@` / `#` trigger suggestion popups (`MentionOption` or `OptionsString`).
- `OTPInput` / `InputOTP`: Segmented one-time verification code input with configurable `Length`, `Mask`, `ShowSeparator`, paste handling, and `OnComplete` callback.
- `FilterBuilder`: Multi-condition query filter builder with `AND`/`OR` operators and `ToTableFilters()` integration for `Table<TItem>`.
- `MarkdownEditor`: Rich Markdown authoring input with formatting toolbar, `Write`/`Preview`/`Split` modes, and word/character counters.
- `CronBuilder`: Visual 5-field cron schedule expression builder (`Minutes`, `Hourly`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, `Monthly`, `Custom`) with human-readable schedule summary.
- `SignaturePad`: Vector SVG digital signature capture pad supporting mouse/touch/pen strokes, `Undo`, `Clear`, and SVG data-URI export.
- `AvatarUpload`: Profile picture uploader with circular/square framing, zoom slider (`1.0x`â€“`2.5x`), 90Â° rotation, and instant data-URI preview.
- `PromptInput`: AI copilot prompt input with suggestion chips (`Suggestions`, `SuggestionsString`), `Enter` submission, and loading/stop state.
- `Upload`: File selector and drag-and-drop dropzone (`DragDrop="true"`) wrapping Blazor `InputFile` with file list management and size validation.

### 4. Data Display
- `Card` & `CardGrid`: Structured container with title, extra action slot, cover image, and card grid layouts.
- `Table<TItem>` & `DataGridVirtual<TItem>`: Customizable data table with manual column definitions (`TableColumn<TItem>`, `Column<TItem>`, `PropertyColumn<TItem, TProp>`, `TemplateColumn<TItem>`), virtualized scrolling (`Virtualize="true"`, `ItemSize`, `ScrollHeight`), sticky columns (`Fixed="ColumnFixed.Left"` / `Right`), resizable headers (`Resizable="true"`), sorting, filtering, pagination, expandable rows, and row selection.
- `CodeBlock`: Syntax-highlighted code block with line numbers, line range highlighting (`HighlightLines="2,4-6"`), collapsible body, and embedded `CopyButton`.
- `DiffViewer`: Side-by-side (`SplitView="true"`) and unified diff comparison viewer with `+N` / `-M` change stats.
- `Gauge` & `MeterGroup`: Semi-circular radial SVG gauge (`role="meter"`) with threshold colors and multi-segment stacked capacity bar (`MeterGroup`) with legend.
- `ChatBubble`: AI/Copilot conversation message bubble (`Placement`, `Author`, `Avatar`, `Typing`, `Streaming`, collapsible `ReasoningSteps`, and copy/feedback actions).
- `KanbanBoard<TItem>`: Multi-column Kanban workflow board with drag-and-drop, accessible card movement buttons, WIP limits (`MaxItems`), and custom `CardTemplate`.
- `Sparkline`: Pure-SVG inline trend chart (`Line`, `Area`, `Bar`) with automatic semantic trend coloring (`Up`, `Down`, `Neutral`).
- `Segmented`: Pill segmented control with smooth selection state, icons, disabled items, and block full-width layout.
- `Carousel` & `CarouselPanel`: Banner slideshow with autoplay, autoplay speed, dot navigation positions, and next/prev arrows.
- `Image` & `ImagePreviewGroup`: Image viewer with hover preview mask, full-screen preview modal supporting Zoom/Rotate, and multi-image lightbox gallery navigation.
- `Tree` & `TreeNode`: Hierarchical collapsible tree view with checkable nodes, folder/file icons, and real-time search filtering.
- `Calendar`: Full-month calendar grid view with month/year navigation, weekday headers, and custom `DateCellTemplate`.
- `QRCode`: SVG QR code display with size, color, background, and loading/expired status states with refresh callback.
- `Watermark`: Security watermark overlay pattern wrapping content with custom text, rotation, font, and spacing gaps.
- `Tag`: Color variants (default, success, warning, error, info, custom hex), closable tags with `OnClose` callback.
- `Badge`: Numeric count badges, overflow ceiling (`OverflowCount="99"`), status indicator dots (`Success`, `Processing`, `Default`, `Error`, `Warning`).
- `Avatar` & `AvatarGroup`: User avatars supporting image `Src` (with automatic fallback), `Icon`, or `Text` initials in `Circle` or `Square` shapes.
- `Collapse` & `CollapsePanel`: Accordion and multi-panel disclosure containers with custom headers and `Extra` slots.
- `Descriptions` & `DescriptionsItem`: Multi-column key/value detail grids with `Bordered` table layout and column `Span` control.
- `Statistic`: KPI metric display with `Title`, `Value`, `Precision` formatting, `Prefix`, and `Suffix`.
- `Timeline` & `TimelineItem`: Vertical chronological event feed with semantic dot colors and custom `Dot` templates.
- `Popover`: Floating rich content card triggered by `Click` or `Hover`.
- `Empty`: Empty state placeholder with customizable icon/image, description, and footer action slot.
- `List<TItem>`, `ListItem`, `ListItemMeta`: Item feeds with avatars, titles, descriptions, action slots, and pagination.

### 5. Feedback
- `Modal`: Accessible dialog, focus trap, escape key dismiss, backdrop click toggle, header, footer, `ConfirmLoading`.
- `IModalService`: Programmatic confirm dialogs: `modalService.ConfirmAsync(new ModalConfirmOptions { Title = "...", Content = "..." })`.
- `Drawer`: Slide-over panel from `Right`, `Left`, `Top`, or `Bottom` with mask backdrop, header, body, and footer slots.
- `Alert`: Alert banners (`Success`, `Info`, `Warning`, `Error`), description, icon, closable with `OnClose`.
- `IMessageService`: Floating toast feedback: `messageService.Success("Saved successfully")`, `messageService.Error("Failed")`.
- `NotificationHost` & `INotificationService`: Desktop-style rich notifications with Title, Description, Type (`Success`, `Info`, `Warning`, `Error`), Placements (`TopRight`, `TopLeft`, `BottomRight`, `BottomLeft`), and action buttons.
- `Tour` & `TourStep`: Step-by-step guided walkthrough popover system with target element highlighting, step count (`1/3`), and Next/Finish buttons.
- `Progress`: Linear and circular progress bars (`ProgressType.Line`, `ProgressType.Circle`) with status colors and custom `Format`.
- `Skeleton`: Animated loading placeholder with configurable `Avatar`, `Title`, and `Rows`.
- `Popconfirm`: Confirmation popover anchored to a trigger element with `OnConfirm` and `OnCancel` callbacks.
- `Result`: Full-section status feedback (`Success`, `Info`, `Warning`, `Error`) with title, subtitle, and `Extra` action buttons.
- `Spin`: Loading spinner with size variants, container wrapping overlay with `Tip` loading text.
- `Tooltip`: Floating tooltip with placement (`Top`, `Bottom`, `Left`, `Right`), trigger events (`Hover`, `Focus`, `Click`).

## Usage Patterns & Code Examples

### Standard Form with Validation
```razor
@using TentoUI

<Form Model="@_model" OnValidSubmit="@HandleSubmit" Layout="FormLayout.Vertical">
    <FormItem Label="Email Address" Required="true" For="@(() => _model.Email)">
        <Input @bind-Value="_model.Email" Placeholder="admin@example.com" AllowClear="true">
            <Prefix><Icon Name="IconNames.Mail" Size="16" /></Prefix>
        </Input>
    </FormItem>

    <FormItem Label="Role" Required="true" For="@(() => _model.RoleId)">
        <Select TItem="RoleItem" TValue="int"
                DataSource="@_roles"
                ValueProperty="@(r => r.Id)"
                LabelProperty="@(r => r.Name)"
                @bind-Value="_model.RoleId"
                Placeholder="Select role" />
    </FormItem>

    <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
        <Button HtmlType="ButtonHtmlType.Submit" Type="ButtonType.Primary" Loading="@_isSubmitting">
            Save Changes
        </Button>
    </div>
</Form>

@code {
    private UserModel _model = new();
    private bool _isSubmitting;
    private List<RoleItem> _roles = new() { new(1, "Administrator"), new(2, "Editor") };

    private async Task HandleSubmit()
    {
        _isSubmitting = true;
        // submit logic
        _isSubmitting = false;
    }

    public record RoleItem(int Id, string Name);
    public class UserModel
    {
        [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Required]
        [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.EmailAddress]
        public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public int RoleId { get; set; }
    }
}
```

### Customizable Table with Manual Columns, Filtering, Sorting, and Pagination
```razor
@using TentoUI

<Table TItem="UserDto"
       DataSource="@_users"
       RowSelection="RowSelectionMode.Multiple"
       @bind-SelectedRows="_selectedUsers"
       @bind-PageIndex="_pageIndex"
       @bind-PageSize="_pageSize"
       ShowSizeChanger="true"
       ShowQuickJumper="true"
       Striped="true">
    <PropertyColumn TItem="UserDto" TProp="int"
                    Property="@(u => u.Id)"
                    Title="ID"
                    Width="80px"
                    Sortable="true" />

    <TableColumn TItem="UserDto"
                 Title="Employee"
                 Property="@(u => u.Name)"
                 Sortable="true"
                 Filterable="true"
                 FilterPlaceholder="Search name..."
                 Context="user">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Avatar Text="@user.Name[..1]" Size="ComponentSize.Small" />
            <span class="font-medium">@user.Name</span>
        </div>
    </TableColumn>

    <TableColumn TItem="UserDto"
                 Title="Role"
                 Property="@(u => u.Role)"
                 Sortable="true"
                 Filterable="true"
                 FilterMode="ColumnFilterMode.Select"
                 FilterOptions="@_roleFilterOptions" />

    <TemplateColumn TItem="UserDto"
                    Title="Status"
                    Sortable="true"
                    SortBy="@(u => u.IsActive)"
                    Filterable="true"
                    FilterBy="@(u => u.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive")">
        <Tag Color="@(context.IsActive ? TagColor.Success : TagColor.Default)">
            @(context.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive")
        </Tag>
    </TemplateColumn>
</Table>

@code {
    private int _pageIndex = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 10;
    private List<UserDto> _users = new();
    private HashSet<UserDto> _selectedUsers = new();
    private readonly ColumnFilterOption[] _roleFilterOptions =
    [
        new("Admin", "Admin"),
        new("Editor", "Editor"),
        new("Viewer", "Viewer")
    ];

    public record UserDto(int Id, string Name, string Role, bool IsActive);
}
```

### Component Wrapping & Extensibility Pattern
When wrapping TentoUI components into domain-specific building blocks:
1. Inherit from `TentoComponentBase` or `TentoInputBase<TValue>`.
2. Forward unmatched attributes to the root element with `@attributes="AdditionalAttributes"`.
3. Compose styling using `CssBuilder` to merge base classes with user-provided `Class`.
4. Provide appropriate default ARIA attributes.

```razor
@namespace MyCompany.Components
@inherits TentoComponentBase

<div class="@ComputedClass" style="@Style" @attributes="AdditionalAttributes">
    <Card Title="@Title">
        <Extra>
            @if (Closable)
            {
                <Button Type="ButtonType.Text" Size="ComponentSize.Small" OnClick="@OnClose">
                    <Icon Name="IconNames.X" Size="14" />
                </Button>
            }
        </Extra>
        @ChildContent
    </Card>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public string? Title { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public bool Closable { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnClose { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }

    private string ComputedClass => new CssBuilder("domain-panel transition-shadow hover:shadow-md")
        .AddClass(Class)
        .Build();
}
```

## Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Guidelines

- **Focus Visibility**: Ensure interactive elements use Tailwind's `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500 focus-visible:outline-none`.
- **Keyboard Navigation**:
  - `Button`: Space / Enter activates click.
  - `Select`: Enter / Space opens dropdown, ArrowUp / ArrowDown traverses options, Enter selects option, Escape closes dropdown.
  - `Modal`: Escape dismisses dialog when `Keyboard="true"`. Tab cycles inside modal container (focus trapping).
  - `RadioGroup`: Arrow keys change selected radio button.
  - `Checkbox`: Spacebar toggles check state.
- **ARIA Attributes**:
  - `aria-expanded` on accordion / submenu triggers.
  - `aria-checked` on checkboxes, radio buttons, and switches.
  - `aria-selected` on active tabs and table rows.
  - `aria-invalid` on form inputs failing validation.
  - `aria-busy="true"` on elements currently in loading state.
  - `aria-modal="true"` on modal dialogs.
  - `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` linking modals and controls to descriptive labels.

## Verification & Testing Method

Verify TentoUI components using bUnit and xUnit:
```bash
# Build TentoUI library
dotnet build src/TentoUI/TentoUI.csproj

# Run bUnit test suite
dotnet test tests/TentoUI.Tests/TentoUI.Tests.csproj
```

In bUnit test classes:
```csharp
using Bunit;
using Xunit;
using FluentAssertions;
using TentoUI;

public class ButtonTests : TestContext
{
    [Fact]
    public void Button_RendersPrimaryStyle_AndHandlesClicks()
    {
        var clicked = false;
        var cut = RenderComponent<Button>(parameters => parameters
            .Add(p => p.Type, ButtonType.Primary)
            .Add(p => p.OnClick, () => clicked = true)
            .AddChildContent("Submit"));

        cut.Find("button").ClassList.Should().Contain("tento-btn-primary");
        cut.Find("button").Click();
        clicked.Should().BeTrue();
    }
}
```

# TentoUI Tailwind Setup Skill

TentoUI components are styled with Tailwind utility classes (`bg-primary-600`, `focus-visible:ring-2`, `dark:bg-slate-900`, ...).
The NuGet package ships **compiled assemblies, not Razor sources**, and `tentoui.min.css` only contains design tokens (`--tento-*`).
**The consuming app must run Tailwind itself**, otherwise components render without most styles. This skill sets that up.

## Use this skill when

- TentoUI was just added to a project (`dotnet add package TentoUI`) and Tailwind is not configured yet.
- Components look unstyled or partially styled, `primary-*` colors are missing, or `dark:` variants do nothing.
- You must wire Tailwind into `dotnet build` / `dotnet publish` / CI / `dotnet watch`.
- You want to change the brand palette, fonts or radius, or add a project-specific wrapper library of components.

## Do not use this skill when

- Choosing or composing TentoUI components (use `tentoui-components`).
- The app uses a Tailwind v3 pipeline with `tailwind.config.js` that cannot be upgraded (see "Tailwind v3 fallback" below).
- Writing backend, CQRS, auth or payments code.

## Core Architecture & Rules

1. **Tailwind v4 only** (CSS-first config). Do not create `tailwind.config.js` for new setups.
2. **Never point Tailwind at the TentoUI DLL.** String literals in .NET assemblies are not scannable. Use the class manifest shipped in the package.
3. **What TentoUI ships** (synced into your project on every build by `build/TentoUI.targets`, into `tailwind/tentoui/`):
   - `tentoui.theme.css` - `@theme` bridge mapping `primary-50..950` to the runtime `--tento-primary-*` variables, plus the `dark` variant (`.dark` or `[data-theme="dark"]`).
   - `tentoui.classes.txt` - every utility class candidate used by the components, for `@source`.
   - Opt out of syncing with `<TentoUISyncTailwind>false</TentoUISyncTailwind>`; change the destination with `<TentoUITailwindTarget>`.
4. **Load order in `<head>`**: `tentoui.min.css` (tokens) first, then the generated `tailwind.css`, then app CSS. Do not also load Bootstrap: Tailwind's preflight replaces it, and both together cause conflicts. Remove the template's `bootstrap.min.css` link and `bootstrap/` folder.
5. **Colors stay runtime-themable.** Never hardcode hex colors in components or wrappers. Brand changes go through `TentoTheme` (C#) or by overriding `--tento-primary-*` variables, not by editing `@theme` palette values.
6. **Generated CSS is a build artifact.** Add `wwwroot/tailwind.css` and `node_modules/` to `.gitignore`; always regenerate it in CI.
7. **Pin versions.** Commit `package-lock.json`, pin `tailwindcss` and `@tailwindcss/cli` to the same version, and use `npm ci` (never `npm install`) in CI.

## API & Architecture Reference

### Files in the consuming project

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Styles/app.tailwind.css` | Tailwind entry: imports Tailwind, TentoUI theme bridge, and `@source` globs |
| `tailwind/tentoui/*` | Synced from the NuGet package at build (do not edit; may be gitignored) |
| `wwwroot/tailwind.css` | Generated, minified output served to the browser |
| `package.json` | `css:build` and `css:watch` scripts, pinned Tailwind packages |

### MSBuild properties (from the TentoUI package)

| Property | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `TentoUISyncTailwind` | `true` | Copy theme + manifest into the project before build |
| `TentoUITailwindTarget` | `$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)\tailwind\tentoui\` | Destination folder |

## Usage Patterns & Code Examples

### 0. Get this skill into your project

The skills ship inside the TentoUI NuGet package. After `dotnet add package TentoUI`, install them once:

```powershell
dotnet msbuild -t:TentoUIInstallSkills                                  # copies to ./.skills/
dotnet msbuild -t:TentoUIInstallSkills -p:TentoUISkillsTarget=.gemini/config/skills/   # other agent folder
```

Or keep them updated on every build with `<TentoUISyncSkills>true</TentoUISyncSkills>` in the `.csproj`.
Pick the folder your AI agent reads (`.skills/`, `.gemini/config/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, ...). Projects scaffolded with `dotnet new tento-clean --enable-ai-skills true` already contain them.

### 1. Install Tailwind

```powershell
npm init -y
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli
npm pkg set scripts.css:build="tailwindcss -i Styles/app.tailwind.css -o wwwroot/tailwind.css --minify"
npm pkg set scripts.css:watch="tailwindcss -i Styles/app.tailwind.css -o wwwroot/tailwind.css --watch"
```

Run `dotnet build` once first so TentoUI syncs `tailwind/tentoui/` into the project.

### 2. `Styles/app.tailwind.css`

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "../tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.theme.css";

/* TentoUI component classes (compiled library - scanned via the shipped manifest) */
@source "../tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.classes.txt";

/* Your own markup. Include every folder that contains Razor/C# with class names. */
@source "../Components/**/*.razor";
@source "../Pages/**/*.razor";
@source "../**/*.cs";
```

Add one `@source` per additional project or wrapper library that uses utility classes (for example `../../MyCompany.Ui/**/*.razor`).

### 3. Wire into the build (build, publish, CI)

```xml
<!-- In the web project's .csproj -->
<Target Name="TailwindBuild" BeforeTargets="BeforeBuild" Condition="'$(SkipTailwind)' != 'true'">
  <Exec Command="npm ci" Condition="!Exists('$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/node_modules')"
        WorkingDirectory="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)" />
  <Exec Command="npm run css:build" WorkingDirectory="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)" />
</Target>
```

- Verified behavior: with `wwwroot/tailwind.css` deleted, `dotnet publish -c Release` regenerates it and includes it in the published `wwwroot`.
- Fast inner loop: pass `-p:SkipTailwind=true` and run `npm run css:watch` in a second terminal next to `dotnet watch`.
- CI: install Node (LTS), run `dotnet publish -c Release`; the target runs `npm ci` automatically.

### 4. Reference the CSS in `App.razor`

```razor
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <base href="/" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="_content/TentoUI/tentoui.min.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="@Assets["tailwind.css"]" />
    <ImportMap />
    <HeadOutlet />
</head>
<body>
    <Routes />
    <script src="_content/TentoUI/tentoui.js"></script>
    <script src="@Assets["_framework/blazor.web.js"]"></script>
</body>
```

`@Assets[...]` (with `app.MapStaticAssets()`) fingerprints the file, giving immutable caching and automatic cache busting in production. Use `href="tailwind.css"` only if the app does not call `MapStaticAssets()`.

### 5. Layout

```razor
<TentoConfigProvider DarkMode="@_dark">
    @Body
    <ModalHost />
    <MessageHost />
</TentoConfigProvider>
```

### 6. Customize the brand palette (runtime, no rebuild)

```csharp
builder.Services.AddTentoUI(theme =>
{
    theme.PrimaryColor = "#7c3aed";
    theme.PrimaryHoverColor = "#6d28d9";
});
```

Or override tokens in CSS loaded after `tentoui.min.css`:

```css
:root { --tento-primary-500: #7c3aed; --tento-primary-600: #6d28d9; }
[data-theme="dark"], .dark { --tento-primary-500: #a78bfa; --tento-primary-600: #c4b5fd; }
```

### 7. Dynamic class names (safelisting)

Tailwind only emits classes it can see as complete strings. This is wrong:

```razor
<div class="@($"bg-{_color}-500")">...</div>   @* never generated *@
```

Use complete class names in a lookup:

```csharp
private static readonly Dictionary<Status, string> StatusClass = new()
{
    [Status.Ok] = "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",
    [Status.Bad] = "bg-red-50 text-red-700",
};
```

For classes that come from a database or CMS, safelist them: `@source inline("bg-emerald-50 bg-red-50");`.

### 8. Wrapper libraries

A project-specific component library that wraps TentoUI must:
1. Reference TentoUI normally.
2. Be added as an `@source` glob in every consuming app's `app.tailwind.css`.
3. Never ship its own Tailwind output; the app owns the single generated stylesheet.

### 9. Tailwind v3 fallback (only if v4 is impossible)

Create `tailwind.config.js` with `content` listing `./**/*.razor`, `./tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.classes.txt`, `darkMode: ['variant', ['&:where(.dark, .dark *, [data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *)']]`, and `theme.extend.colors.primary` set to `var(--tento-primary-50)` ... `var(--tento-primary-950)`. Prefer migrating to v4.

## Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Guidelines

- Keep TentoUI's `focus-visible:ring-*` classes working: never add global `outline: none` or purge `focus-visible` variants.
- When changing `--tento-primary-*`, verify 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for UI components against both light and dark surfaces.
- Do not override `--tento-border-focus` with a low-contrast value.
- Respect user motion settings in app CSS: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }`.

## Verification & Testing Method

After setup, confirm each of these:

```powershell
dotnet build                      # tailwind/tentoui/ exists, wwwroot/tailwind.css generated
dotnet publish -c Release -o out  # out/wwwroot contains the fingerprinted tailwind css
```

1. `wwwroot/tailwind.css` is non-trivial (tens of KB) and contains `focus-visible\:ring-2`, `text-primary-500`, and `var(--tento-primary-600)`.
2. Rendering `<Button Type="ButtonType.Primary">Hi</Button>` shows a filled primary button, with a visible focus ring on keyboard focus.
3. Toggling `DarkMode` on `<TentoConfigProvider>` switches surfaces and `dark:` variants.
4. A change to a class in your own `.razor` file appears after `npm run css:build`.
5. In the browser dev tools, no `404` for `tailwind.css`, `tentoui.min.css` or `tentoui.js`.
6. CI starts from a clean checkout and still produces the stylesheet (`node_modules` and `wwwroot/tailwind.css` are not committed).

If components are still unstyled, check in this order: `@source` paths (relative to the CSS file), the synced `tailwind/tentoui/` folder, the `<link>` order, and that no Bootstrap stylesheet is loaded.
